description:
Follow your heart. Follow the trees. Consult the compass. Jump fences, jump streams. Climb many mountains. Get very lost. Find a new place, call it home. There are no wrong turns.

An all-terrain arrow designed for every adventure, built for speed, comfort and class-leading customisation. Its wrapped tubes and unique structural composition help you float over the worst surfaces, dampening the bad vibes and leaving only the good to keep you calm, confident and comfortably in control.

Deep experience with composites led us to weave KRAIBON® throughout the frame, an advanced material that acts like a rubber elastomer, reducing resonances and high frequency vibrations. Combined with sections engineered with a special composite material designed to resist small impacts, Gravel TA is ready to roll over the roughest terrain that comes your way.

TA comes in a PLUS version with cables fully integrated into the cockpit, or a standard version with cables external to the handlebar.

One of the many benefits of making everything in-house is our ability to change anything on demand. Want to add luggage rack attachments, or fork holes for a front cage? Consider it done.

Gravel TA / Plus can easily accommodate 700c wheels with tires of up to 48mm or 650b wheels with tires of up to 2.1 ’, both with single and double transmission.
